description: This file defines the 'ECB' controller class for the OpenCart admin extension related to currency management. It handles displaying the ECB currency settings page, saving configuration changes, and fetching currency exchange rates from the European Central Bank.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: Controller class for managing ECB currency exchange rates and settings within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the currency ECB configuration page with breadcrumbs, header, footer, and the current setting state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the updated currency settings, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches current exchange rates from the ECB API and updates the currency values in the database if enabled.
